Necessity per prerequisite: the conventions need the help globals for the phrase they give a referent and the Where-clause for the shared-conventions promise they pin down — without either, fixing line discipline is motiveless. Fail if any edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: plainness and line discipline contradict neither human-readable nor same-conventions-as-normal-output. Fail on any contradiction.
content.rationale: The dangling human-readable phrase finally gets a checkable referent; the gate forces the conventions to match exactly what the help nodes promise.
